Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
chore: scaffold monorepo structure with shared types

Set up /apps/api, /apps/web, /packages/shared directory structure.
Add Pydantic models and TypeScript types for the suggest API contract.
Include Makefile, docker-compose.yml, .env.example files, and sample fixtures.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -C /c/dev/repos/SPICE commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
UI: spread feedback pills, right-align share/save, restyle export card

- Feedback pills now flex evenly across the row instead of stacking
- Share and Save icon buttons right-aligned
- Export card image redesigned to match SPICE branding: #111 bg,
  amber I logo, red accent bar, border-separated footer

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -C /c/dev/repos/SPICE commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
UI: fix feedback pills wrapping and keep share buttons in card

Feedback pill labels now use whitespace-nowrap so "Too salty" etc.
stay on a single line instead of breaking between words.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -C /c/dev/repos/SPICE commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
UI: sticky header with frosted glass backdrop

Header now stays pinned at the top when scrolling with a
backdrop-blur translucent background so content bleeds through
subtly. Left column sticky offset adjusted to sit below header.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -C /c/dev/repos/SPICE commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
UI: fix share/save buttons appearing outside feedback card

The hidden 400px export card was stretching the flex child width,
pushing the share/save buttons beyond the Card boundary. Fixed by
making the hidden export div absolute-positioned so it doesn''t
affect layout.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -C /c/dev/repos/SPICE commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
UI: keep share/save buttons right-aligned when feedback dismisses

FeedbackButtons returns null after submission, which caused the
share/save buttons to jump left. Added ml-auto to ShareCard so
it always stays pinned to the right side of the card.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -C /c/dev/repos/SPICE commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
UI: wrap feedback pills on mobile, use native share sheet

- Feedback pills now flex-wrap so they reflow on narrow screens
  instead of overflowing or squishing
- Parent card uses flex-wrap with share/save pinned right via
  ml-auto shrink-0
- Share button now tries: file share → text-only share → download,
  so mobile gets the native share sheet instead of just a download

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
